title: Pre-bankruptcy credit counseling
facts: An individual generally must receive credit counseling from an approved organization during the 180-day period before filing bankruptcy, subject to limited statutory exceptions.
The counseling provider must be approved for the federal judicial district where the case will be filed.
Credit counseling before filing is separate from the debtor-education course generally required after filing to receive a discharge.
The U.S. Trustee Program maintains approved provider lists for most jurisdictions, while separate arrangements apply in Alabama and North Carolina.
